newsitem.title: USA: USDA's Glickman to visit hurricane damaged N.C.
newsitem.headline: USDA's Glickman to visit hurricane damaged N.C.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman will tour parts of North Carolina damaged by Hurricane Fran, USDA said Monday.
"I intend to get a first-hand look at the damage and let state and local officials know that the full resources of the USDA are committed to the recovery effort," Glickman said.
He said the hurricane caused millions of dollars in damages to farming and livestock operations. Friday, USDA dispatched several emergency response teams to help in the aftermath of the storm.
Hurricane Fran raged across North Carolina late last week, killing at least 15 people.
